extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/registrants before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; parties interested in reinstatement/disciplinary proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative decision granting a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO following submission of a petition and an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58. Records the Director of Enrollment and Discipline's review and grant of reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of David J. Mahalek received on August 13, 2018.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal petition must be filed and is the primary filing to commence consideration for reinstatement; the Office will review the petition as part of its decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Mahalek has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit filed under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is a required/supporting document for reinstatement petitions and will be considered by the Director in determining whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, and the supporting affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Mahalek to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director weighs the petition and supporting materials and issues a decision (grant or denial); this decision is the operative determination for reinstatement.
